title: CCAI Insights AutoLabeling Rules Configuration
description: Declarative YAML/JSON schema for configuring CCAI Insights AutoLabeling Rules.

project_id.description: Google Cloud Project ID hosting CCAI Insights.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the autolabeling rule.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for the rule.

label_key.description: The metadata label key to write to conversation labels.

label_key_type.description: The category type of the label key.

active.description: Whether the autolabeling rule is actively evaluated on incoming conversations.

conditions.description: Ordered list of CEL conditions evaluated top-to-bottom. The last condition should be '' for default fallback.

condition.description: CEL boolean expression (empty string '' matches anything as default fallback).

value.description: CEL literal or expression representing the label value to set.
